description: Sustainable software product development with Claude Code: 13 skills for the engineering lifecycle — plan, build, test, review, audit — built to keep architecture maintainable and clean and security first-class while agents write the code. Whether a PR may merge is decided by a script with an exit code and, above it, a human — never the model. Ships the merge gate, the quality-catalog system (one master, three generated variants), 27 enforcement scripts and 300+ tests founded on shipped bugs.
